description: Submit a release to the stores/outlets — the FINAL action that sends it out; run_release_checks (check validate) should pass first. The server enforces the account’s weekly submission limit. Reuse the SAME idempotency_key when retrying an unobserved call; without one each call is a new submission.

idempotency_key.description: Deduplicated by the server for 24h — reuse the SAME key when retrying a call whose outcome you did not observe.

name: distribute_release
title: Distribute a release
